text: Hello! Lovely to see you. Happy National Day! Enjoy the holiday! Welcome to your weather report for Thursday, October 1. It's Thursday, almost the end of the week. Remember, our theme this week is blustery days. What have you noticed today? And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
